snippet.title: Thekku Island – Malayalam Horror Game Reveal | Set in 1980s Kerala ( Early Gameplay Trailer)
snippet.description:
Step into the haunting silence of a forgotten island...
Thekku Island is a first-person horror mystery game set in the remote backwaters of 1980s Kerala, India.
This teaser showcases real in-game footage captured from an early development build.

🕯️ Explore an eerie traditional house.
🛶 Arrive by boat to an abandoned island.
🕵️‍♂️ Uncover the mystery behind a missing woman.
🔥 Every corner holds a story… every silence hides a secret.

🎮 This is actual in-game gameplay (not pre-rendered).
🚧 The game is still in development – visuals, performance, and features may improve in the final release.

🖤 Indie horror inspired by Kerala folklore and local storytelling.
✨ Made with Unreal Engine 5 by Me.

📌 Wishlist on Steam 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3889480/Thekku_Island/
💬 Like, comment, and share if you’re excited!
